meta.title: 用一团毛线帮你搞懂「调色曲线」
meta.title_en: Understand the Color Curve With a Ball of Yarn

scenes.title_en: Yarn analogy: this is my friend, and these…
scenes.context: 毛线团的亮暗排序和毛衣对比度调整。
sentences: 你这是属于拍脑门，有没有更严谨的方法？
That's a gut call—is there a more rigorous method?
gut call（拍脑门）
把毛线团从亮到暗分类排序。
Sort the yarn balls from bright to dark.
sort by brightness（按亮排序）
只要先降低亮部，再提高暗部，对比度就降低了。
Lower the highlights and lift the shadows to cut contrast.
lower highlights（降低亮部）
scenes.speak: That's a gut call—is there a more rigorous method? Sort the yarn balls from bright to dark. Lower the highlights and lift the shadows to cut contrast.

scenes.title_cn: 像素与直方图：哎，先别走。我突然感觉…
scenes.title_en: Pixels and histograms: wait, blue doesn't …
scenes.context: 像素像毛线团，直方图按亮暗排序。
sentences: 在计算机的世界里，有一种东西很接近让不吐头崩溃的毛线团，没错，就是组成图像的像素。
In the computer world, pixels closely resemble the yarn that breaks him.
pixels like yarn（像素似毛线）
一张4K分辨率的图像包含的像素块达到880万以上。
A 4K image contains over 8.8 million pixels.
8.8 million（880万）
将像素从左到右、从暗到亮进行排列，形成我们熟悉的直方图。
Sort pixels dark to bright, forming the familiar histogram.
histogram（直方图）
scenes.speak: In the computer world, pixels closely resemble the yarn that breaks him. A 4K image contains over 8.8 million pixels. Sort pixels dark to bright, forming the familiar histogram.

scenes.title_cn: 调色曲线原理：那么，计算机会如何对图…
scenes.title_en: The color-curve principle: how does the co…
scenes.context: 曲线关联像素属性，拉动即调整。
sentences: 计算机中的调色曲线也是类似的原理。
The computer's color curve works the same way.
same principle（同样原理）
清楚曲线关联的像素的什么属性，以及拉动曲线时变化的是什么，就能快速上手所有软件中的调色曲线。
Know what a curve maps and what pulling changes—master any curve.
know the mapping（懂关联）
我们可以通过拉动曲线让亮部更亮、暗部更暗，增加图像的对比度。
Pull to brighten highlights and darken shadows for more contrast.
more contrast（增加对比度）
调色曲线的原理并不复杂，但让我们能够随心所欲地调整现实中难以改变的颜色。
The curve is simple yet lets us freely adjust hard-to-change colors.
freely adjust colors（随心调色）
scenes.speak: The computer's color curve works the same way. Know what a curve maps and what pulling changes—master any curve. Pull to brighten highlights and darken shadows for more contrast. The curve is simple yet lets us freely adjust hard-to-change colors.

practice: Sort yarn balls bright to dark to judge overall tone.
Lower highlights and lift shadows to cut contrast.
Pixels sort dark-to-bright into the histogram.
A curve maps a pixel attribute; pulling changes it.
White maps brightness; red maps red amount; hue maps hue.
pitfalls: 凭直觉看偏亮偏暗不严谨。
Want a single curve to do everything.
Each curve maps one pixel attribute.
Forget what the white line controls.
RGB's white line maps overall brightness.
Only use RGB for color shifts.
The red curve shifts red vs cyan in highlights/shadows.
Its principle is simple—just know the mapping.
shifts: 说调色只会说 color grade
用 color curve（调色曲线）、histogram（直方图）、pixel mapping（像素映射）
用 highlights and shadows（亮部暗部）、contrast（对比度）、dark-toned/bright-toned（暗调亮调）
用 hue curve（色相曲线）、red vs cyan（红青）、saturation（饱和度）
